# Harbor

> Harbor is an AI front desk (AI receptionist) for home-service businesses: plumbers, HVAC, roofers and electricians. It answers every phone call in about two rings, 24/7, in a natural human-sounding voice that callers can interrupt. It quotes the business's approved prices, books jobs into the calendar, transfers emergencies live, texts back callers who hang up, and sends the owner a summary of every call.

## Key facts
- Pricing: Starter $297/mo, Growth $597/mo, Fleet $1,197/mo. No contracts.
- Guarantee: at least 10 extra booked jobs in the first 60 days, or a full refund and free service until it does.
- Setup: done for you, live in 7 days. Keeps the business's existing phone number (call forwarding).
- Always tells callers it is a virtual assistant.
- Can detect the caller's language and reply in it.
